storage.title: Data location
storage.confirm: All data (sessions, credentials, voice models…) will move to {path} on next launch; a link stays at the old location so old records keep working. Pick an empty folder on a non-system drive (the install folder is usually on C: and is wiped on uninstall).
storage.relocatedNote: Moved; {path} is a link to this folder
storage.lastFailed: The last move didn't finish and nothing was changed: {error}
storage.stranded: The original data folder is missing but the pre-move backup is intact: {path} (rename it back to agent to restore)
storage.leftover: Moved, but the old backup couldn't be removed; you can delete it: {path}
storage.notMovable: Portable and test builds decide the data location at launch
cu.title: Computer use
cu.desc: Let Inkstone read the windows on screen and click, type and switch apps — for desktop programs without a command line. Every action really happens on your computer.
cu.needUv: Requires uv (Python tool manager). Turning this on lets uv download Python 3.13 and windows-mcp into your uv cache.
cu.uvInstalled: uv is installed. You can turn on computer use now.
cu.preparing: Preparing: the first run downloads Python and windows-mcp, this can take a minute or two…
cu.enabled: On. Available from the next turn; only screen reading, click, type, scroll, shortcuts and app switching are exposed.
cu.scope: Provided by the open-source windows-mcp; shell, file, registry and process tools stay off.
